title: Settings
apiKeysDescription: Configure access credentials and parameters. Keys are stored locally in your browser.
wireProtocolDescription: Wire protocol used when calling the model gateway. Conversation content and billing stay identical; defaults to OpenAI Chat Completions.
profileSubtitle: Configure your personal information, nickname settings and primary display avatars.
billingSubtitle: Review your current service level, upcoming cycles and billing history details.
planDescription: Full speed priority inference, artifact generation, advanced tools enabled.
priorityApi: Priority API access for Gemini, OpenAI and Anthropic
extendedContext: Extended context token allocation up to 128k
playgroundTools: Multiple image rendering and canvas playground tools
usageSubtitle: Monitor message quotas, token cycles, and generated assets limits.
sessionsSubtitle: Review active logged-in device profiles and discard remote accesses if you trace leaks.
suspiciousAlert: Have you noticed suspicious entry locations or terminal logins? Reset your third-party API Keys and refresh your environment parameters immediately inside settings modal.
developerSubtitle: Deliver secondary software integrations rapidly using our client-side Core Service patterns.
usageEmptyDescription: Token, message and image quotas are provided by the platform billing service. Real usage will appear here once the membership service is connected.
